subject: general
question: The role of _____________ is to be ready to lend to banks at all times and so it is said to be the lender of last resort.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India,**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Reserve bank of India act as the lender of last resort. Central banks have traditionally clasp this role because **they are primarily the ones in control of for ensuring that financial markets function smoothly and the financial system is firm.**
 
• **It can come to the rescue of a bank that is solvent but faces temporary liquidity difficulties by supplying it with much needed liquidity when no one else is willing to extend credit to that bank**.
 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is India's central bank, also known as **the banker's bank**.
 
• The **RBI regulate the monetary and other banking policies **of the Indian government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Consolidation fund of India**__ -​ **the account of the revenue the Government of India collect — via income tax, Customs, central excise and non-tax revenue — and the cost, it makes, keep out exceptional items**.
 
• The** World Bank **has been censured as promoting affectation and harming economic development. 
 
• **State Bank of India** (**SBI**) is an Indian international public sector bank.
